tasks.source: The same 10 held-out eval tasks as eval-v2.json (NOAA ISD + IGRA2 2020-2024 weather, synthetic facilities, EPA AERMOD 26135 / BPIPPRM 04274, ARM2 for NO2, discrete height menus).
tasks.selection: The frozen eval cohort of eval-v2.json, three repeats per model and task, seeds fixed. No training task is in it; train and eval are separated by weather station.

harness.notes: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B at revision 1d4bf0f2ff60, bf16, Transformers generation on one H200, thinking off, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, 32,768 output tokens per reply, 1800 s wall clock per episode. Tool results carry a turns-left line; one retry after an empty reply and a correction prompt after a malformed call. Not the frontier harness of eval-v2.json; the two cards are not compared.

grading.reference: Same as eval-v2.json: reward is the feasible saved fraction of the draft design cost, verified with native BPIP/AERMOD; invalid, infeasible or no submission scores zero; 1.0 would require zero cost and is unreachable.
grading.reward: (cost(draft) - cost(submission)) / cost(draft). Equal task weight after averaging repeats; 95% station-clustered percentile bootstrap (5 stations, 2000 draws, seed 0).
